summary: #135291 remains the canonical open bug. Latest main statically retains the ownerless core Skill Workshop approval path, but this worker cannot create or validate the required repair: the checkout is read-only, ../codex is absent (a mandatory direct-inspection gate), and pnpm cannot initialize Corepack on the read-only filesystem.

actions.reason: A writable checkout with the required sibling Codex source is needed before any code change or implementation verdict; focused tests also require an installable package-manager cache.
